summary.text: Seven Illusions true inheritance is a legacy whose complete inheritor accepts an alliance agreement of seven things, seven conditions across seven layers.

claims.text: On a nameless mountain, Purple Mountain True Monarch meets a mysterious Gu Immortal covered in rainbow light and tells him that, regardless of how that immortal obtained the complete Seven Illusions true inheritance, the alliance agreement he has already made obliges him to do seven things. He orders two killings first: Wu Yi Ran, then Yao Geng.

At blood tide pit, Purple Mountain True Monarch corners the rainbow-lit inheritor and tells him he must pay what the alliance agreement demands; the inheritor cannot refuse, since the information path alliance agreement inside the true inheritance would restrict him even without Purple Mountain True Monarch’s rank eight strength, and at Purple Mountain True Monarch’s order he kills Wu clan’s Wu Yuan Ju and Rong Hao with Qiao Zhi Cai’s wooden statue murder, framing Qiao clan for the deaths.

After two corpses are found, Tie Mian Shen of Tie clan tells Wu Yong that someone mimicked Qiao Zhi Cai’s immortal killer move wooden statue murder, and he names the culprit a Seven Illusions Demon Immortal, meaning an inheritor of Seven Illusions true inheritance. Wu Yong recalls the saying that an inheritor gains a method to mimic almost any Gu Immortal method in the world, and Tie Mian Shen confirms that reputation. Tie clan’s Demon Suppression Tower once held a Seven Illusions Demon Immortal; the clan never obtained the inheritance’s contents, but learned many of its secrets. The inheritance has seven layers: an inheritor may take any layer or the complete set, and each inherited layer adds one future condition to fulfill for someone, so all seven layers mean seven conditions. Tie clan has methods to locate such an inheritor and to differentiate their methods, and Tie Mian Shen used them to confirm the case.

Near Yi Tian Mountain, the Seven Illusions Demon Immortal is trapped in a ball of wind in front of Clear Jade Dripping Wind Tiny Bamboo Building until he surrenders, and Wu Yong strips away the rainbow light to expose Yao clan Gu Immortal Yao Geng. Yao Geng says he acted as a pawn under the alliance, not for Yao clan, and he links that compulsion to Seven Illusions true inheritance. Tie Mian Shen states that obtaining the inheritance requires an information path alliance agreement that Tie clan judged a trap, and that many earlier inheritors never had to execute their agreement, while Yao Geng is the first victim they know of.
